mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'

TLS certificate verification is required on all builds of this project, development builds included; no build type is exempt. This follows the project's recorded policy of HTTPS everywhere with no plaintext exception.

cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md
